title: The High Stakes One Day Wager — Part 3

series.summary: Rentaro refuses to give up on Nano and chases her down, but she recites pi at supersonic speed to tune him out. In a desperate gamble, Rentaro wagers a one-day date: if she feels nothing, he promises to leave her alone forever. Calculating a net gain in future efficiency, Nano accepts.

segments.voiceover_text: Refusing to surrender her soul to empty calculation, Rentaro chases after Nano once again through the crowded school halls.
To drown out his heartfelt pleas, Nano rapidly rattles off endless digits of pi with machine-gun speed and icy precision.
Rentaro steps directly into her path, fiercely insisting that true living requires love, messy human feelings, and warm shared moments.
He boldly wagers everything on a single desperate proposal: grant him just one day together on an unforgettable date.
Calculating that one afternoon permanently eliminates years of persistent disruption, Nano rationally accepts his high-stakes wager and terms.
